name: Tri Attack
description: You strike with a simultaneous three-beam attack. Each creature in a 30 foot cone, centered on you, must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 2d6 + MOVE normal damage on a fail, and half as much on a success. Targets that fail the save by 5 or more must roll a d6, gaining the status condition as follows:
higherLevels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 4d6 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.
